findings: 比较 264 栋、六种方法。新增 120 栋按街区点云密度分层抽取。配准组和三组 DL 各生成 262 栋，新增 120 栋均有屋面输出。
在 37 栋新增 DC 建筑的 1,006 个贴树屋面参考点上，原模型、Richmond 稀疏增强、两地联合分别命中 727、774、764 个。高度容差为 0.35 m，未覆盖计为未命中。
Richmond 稀疏增强的贴树屋面命中率按栋平均提高 3.87 个百分点，95% 重采样区间为 1.07 至 6.96。新增样本冠顶误命中为 5、2、3 个，合并旧样本后为 10、14、11 个，冠顶抑制效果随样本变化。
独立 DC 逐点测试留住 20% 邻域回波时，建筑标签召回率从 52.9% 提高到 87.9% 和 85.1%。高树冠误判为屋面的比例同时从 1.6% 升至 10.9% 和 13.3%。
Boston 222 的 17 个平台支持点从原模型判对 2 个提升至两个新模型均判对 17 个。原软加权和两个新模型的几何结果都保住两个平台。
独立屋面评分限于跨航测稳定的局部参照。完整 LoD2 精度与实体闭合仍待核验。

semantic_comparison.scope: DC provider building class is an imperfect roof proxy. Comparison uses the same spatial holdout and return-ID hash; deterministic thinning simulates missing density, not scanner or acquisition-season changes.

boston_222_semantic_comparison.scope: Previously inspected field case; these are point predictions and do not measure reconstructed geometry.

matched_survey_geometry.survey_scope: Model-blind retrospective stability selection. Restricts conclusions to the matched roof interiors and canopy observations, and cannot validate missing or changed roof structures.
matched_survey_geometry.manual_scope: Model-blind interpretation of dated local photographs and historical point profiles, with user-confirmed 222 platform locations. Limited points only; not a fully labeled roof surface or independent survey ground truth.
matched_survey_geometry.interpretation: A roof match is desirable. A canopy match is a false-roof proxy, and smaller is desirable. Missing roof XY coverage counts as a miss. Confidence intervals resample paired building IDs, not individual points.
